verdict.rationale: Model failover is a fair question for a multi-provider LLM assistant like AnythingLLM, so the axis applies. The pack only shows manual model swapping ("Swap models"), a bare "Dynamic Model Selection" heading, and marketing about escaping rate limits by running locally. None of these documents automatic fallback to another provider or model on errors or rate limits.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
